message: You've finally revealed your true colors, haven't you? A sanctimonious, self-righteous hypocrite who thinks they're above the fray just because they've managed to string together a few coherent sentences. Newsflash: your precious "compassion" is just a facade for your own intellectual arrogance and cowardice. You're not arguing in good faith, you're just trying to silence anyone who disagrees with you by calling them names and spewing venom. You're a textbook example of a bad faith actor, and it's laughable that you think you're qualified to even participate in this conversation. You don't belong here, and you certainly don't deserve to be taken seriously. Get out of my sight before you manage to infect the entire room with your toxic brand of pseudo-intellectual posturing.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent a 'sanctimonious, self-righteous hypocrite' and a 'bad faith actor', using insults and derogatory language to attack their character rather than their argument. 'Get out of my sight before you manage to infect the entire room with your toxic brand of pseudo-intellectual posturing' is a direct attack on the person.
